steps.name: Provide the macOS /private/tmp path on Linux
Install PostgreSQL 17 from PGDG
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg
sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings
curl --silent --show-error --location --output /tmp/pgdg.asc https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
test -s /tmp/pgdg.asc
head -1 /tmp/pgdg.asc | grep -q "BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK"
sudo cp /tmp/pgdg.asc /etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.asc
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.asc] http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt $(lsb_release --short --codename)-pgdg main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17
